# ApiFlash

> ApiFlash is a website screenshot API. A single HTTPS endpoint captures pixel perfect screenshots of any URL with an up to date version of Chrome running on AWS Lambda, and returns the image (jpeg, png or webp) or a JSON document with links to it.

Every API call is authenticated with an access key, available in the dashboard after signing up. The free plan includes 100 screenshots per month.
